name: classday
description: An offline Android planner that helps university students find a realistic daily rhythm.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run audit:english
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && node scripts/android-apk.mjs debug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && node scripts/android-signing.mjs && node scripts/android-apk.mjs release
